blocks.html: Major real estate players Robinsons Land Corporation and Federal Land Corporation sets the pace faster for its joint venture project, Axis Residences located along Pioneer Street, Manadaluyong City as it simultaneously preps up for two exciting developments at the start of the year.

The first tower of Axis Residences now stands strikingly tall in the Pioneer cityscape as it starts to welcome its first batch home owners. With committed services and facilities for the development all in place, unit owners of the Axis Residences – Tower A can now enjoy the fruits of their hard-earned money by enjoying the apt selection of amenities like the swimming pool, multi-purpose covered court and fitness center to name a few.

And as the turnover team engages into full action to welcome more unit owners of Axis Residences Tower A in the coming months, the sales team shifts into full gear as they start with the pre-selling of Tower B with unit selections that goes well for young professionals, millennials and even investors who are very cautious making the right purchase choices and at the same time thinks than key to looking for a wise home and investment are the project’s immediacy to convenience and accessibility to key urban districts.

With a beautiful showcase units as well as the solid and skillful craftsmanship evident in the construction and design of the Tower A, the future all looks promising for the second tower of Axis Residences.
